performance_history.note: No prior real newsletter issue to grade. The only published post was a placeholder titled 'New post' (post_a6a02adf..., published 2026-05-31) sent to a single test recipient. Baseline at run time: 14 active subscribers, +2 net new in 7 days, 0.0% open/click (no real campaign sent yet), earnings $2.24 (7 days).

Graded issue #7 (post_178199d6-8943-47a0-bccb-b38b778953f8, 'Putin's Kuril Islands Visit...', sent 2026-08-17), the most recent published issue. Issues 2-7 ran on branch claude/peaceful-euler-xrn9km and were never recorded in this branch's state, so this branch skipped from issue 1 to issue 8. Issue #7 performance: 13 sent, 13 delivered (100%), open rate 30.77% (4 unique opens), click rate 50% raw / 25% verified (2 unique raw email clicks, 1 verified), 1 unsubscribe (7.69%), 0 spam, 0 web views. Publication now 12 active subscribers, down from 14 at issue #1. Last 7 days flat (0 new, 0 churned, $0.00 earnings) because no issue was sent in the ~7 weeks since 2026-08-17. Takeaways: open rate held up on a tiny list; the single unsubscribe weighs heavily at this list size; the main drag is the long publishing gap, so cadence matters more than any single-issue tweak.
